Data provenance. This is a synthetic (programmatically generated) dataset — the “Indian E-Commerce Customer & Order Intelligence” set, generated with a documented Python script (seed 42). Customer names, product names, brands and campaign names are fabricated; no real person, company or transaction is represented. It is released CC0. Figures here are therefore illustrative of method, not of any real market.
Revenue definition. Revenue is Delivered + Returned orders at item level (excludes shipping and tax). Returned orders are included because the sale happened and returns are tracked separately — the return-rate KPI above shows the exposure, and the net-of-returns figure is given alongside it.
Slicers. Multi-select. Charts marked Month ignored aggregate at a coarser grain for payload size.
Source. 254,331 order lines · 100,000 orders · 15 states · 22 categories · 550 products.
